CustomField.description: Where the sale is waiting on someone else. Orange: a discount is waiting for approval (Showroom Manager, Finance or Head Office, US-02), or an instalment sale is with Finance (plan set-up, Head of Finance sign-off, deposit, US-29). Green: instalment plan signed off and deposit received (ready to close), or the discount was approved. Red: discount rejected.
CustomField.formula: IF(IsClosed, NULL, IF(Pending_Discount_Requests__c > 0, "🟠 " & BLANKVALUE(Discount_Step__c, "Discount waiting for approval"), IF(AND(ISPICKVAL(Payment_Mode__c, "Instalment"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Payment Arranged")), IF(AND(Signed_Off_Plans__c > 0, Down_Payment_Received__c > 0), "🟢 Ready to close: plan signed off and deposit received", IF(Signed_Off_Plans__c > 0, "🟠 With Finance: plan signed off, waiting for the deposit", IF(Down_Payment_Received__c > 0, "🟠 With Finance: deposit received, waiting for plan sign-off", "🟠 With Finance: payment plan being set up"))), IF(CONTAINS(Discount_Step__c, "approved"), "🟢 " & Discount_Step__c, IF(CONTAINS(Discount_Step__c, "rejected"), "🔴 " & Discount_Step__c, NULL)))))
CustomField.label: AM Approval Status
